comments.author: @UnseenWorldDocs_Us
comments.text:
Would you live in a village where no men are allowed? In this Kenya documentary, we visit a village in the dry north run entirely by women, then follow 2 million animals toward a river full of crocodiles. What these women built there, and why, may surprise you.
👇 Your pick: the women-only village, or the Great Migration? Tell us in the comments, and subscribe for the next journey.
#Kenya #KenyaDocumentary #TravelAfrica

comments.author: @Top10Documentary999
comments.text: Kenya is full of contrasts that make you think deeply about life. 🇰🇪❤ A village where women build a community without men, millions of wild animals roaming freely, and rivers that can be both beautiful and deadly—it's incredible how people adapt to such different realities. I’d love to understand more about the challenges these communities face every day. Which part of Kenya’s story surprised you the most? 🌍🤔

replies.author: @UnseenWorldDocs_Us
replies.text: The women-only village definitely stood out to me. It’s fascinating how a community can rebuild itself around safety, independence, and mutual support. I’d love to know how daily life there has changed for the younger generation.
